target_customer: Busy professionals who manage many work contacts
problem: Professionals forget context about their contacts; Prompt connects calendar and email to maintain relationships.
business_model: Consumer or prosumer app (model not stated)
product_category: Personal relationship CRM and contacts app

founders.name: Bobby Meelu
founders.background_notes: Sole founder on the YC page; his Product Hunt post calls him co-founder.

founders.name: Vincent Liu
founders.background_notes: Named as a founder in a search summary of the YC listing; not seen on the fetched YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Contacts sync with calendar and email; standard integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Contact apps are easily copied and phone and email vendors own the data.

market_need_then: Relationship tracking tools existed, but no source documents demand for this product.

branding.domain_note: Product Hunt page titled Prompt Contacts and Calendar; site getprompt.app per YC listing.

brand_strength.rationale: Very generic name shared with many companies; database profiles mix it up with other Prompts.

outcome_analysis: Prompt was a one person Summer 2019 YC company building a contacts app tied to calendar and email. It is listed Inactive with no shutdown notice, funding article or post-mortem found, so the cause is not public. The generic name made even its funding data hard to separate from other companies called Prompt.
notes: No website listed on the directory record so site treated as dead or unknown. The pre seed round is only a label on a Crunchbase search result with no amount; Dealroom shows garbled 125k and 150k seeds that were not used. CB Insights Prompt totals belong to other companies. Competitor search found only current alternatives (Monica, Clay, Dex) with no 2019 dates, so the list is empty. The brand_confusion failure factor is a weak inference from name genericness.
